parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test files: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/AppConfigurationTests.swift' (package: AppServices) and 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceHTTPTests.swift' (package: Metadata). Although the context_flags do not explicitly mark is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both type-alias-object declarations inside *Tests targets, which are test fixtures by location. Each test package independently defines a local MockURLProtocol alias scoped to its own test bundle; this is the canonical pattern for isolating URL-loading stubs per test module. Consolidating them into a shared target would couple two otherwise independent test packages and risk leaking test infrastructure into production dependency graphs.
